about: What each in-app purchase is called and says in App Store Connect and Google Play, and its App Review screenshot. The name is the buy screen's own (OFFER_NAME in src/billing/offers.ts); the App Store description is the text entered in App Store Connect (store/paid-files.json storeText where it exists); the Play description is what ~/bin/play-products writes (scripts/store/play-products.mjs reads it from here). The owner or coordinator enters names, descriptions and screenshots in the consoles; no agent does. test/storeFiles.unit.ts holds every line here to the app, the store limits and the screenshot files.
